analysis.summary: Accent Microcell held its earnings conference call on May 16, 2026, to discuss financial and operational results for the half year and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. Management highlighted growth driven by premium products like MCC spheres and SMCC, increasing export revenue share, and progress on Unit 3 (Phase 1 and Phase 2) expansions despite regulatory and monsoon-related delays. The company noted strong MCC demand, an existing order book of roughly 4,000 metric tons, and plans to fund upcoming phases through internal accruals and rights issues. Management also addressed queries regarding wood pulp import costs, trading volumes, and working capital cycles. Accent Microcell Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, showcasing strong revenue growth and expanding manufacturing capacities.
